approval.rationale: Design-only candidate in the existing approved-contract schema, not self-approval. Independent design/destructive review, authorized merge, exact-main closure and separate L3.3 runtime authorization are required. This unchanged contract and its normative companion docs/governance/cross_day_dataset_atomic_publication_v1.md must precede implementation in BASE. No runtime, platform qualification or same-PR implementation is approved here.

identity.name: Multi-Source Cross-Day Dataset atomic publication v1
identity.purpose: Version multi-source-cross-day-dataset-atomic-publication-v1. Publish one fully privately verified Cross-Day Dataset through qualified same-filesystem atomic no-replace publication, with an invocation-private complete content/object seal. Cleanup covers only this invocation's proven uncommitted staging. Frozen Dataset layout, 49-field identity and reader semantics remain unchanged.

implementation_bindings.rationale: Exactly one Windows-only qualified non-replacing os.rename for the sealed invocation-owned sibling staging to its exact dataset_id=<ID> destination. Existing destination must be refused; no generic move, POSIX rename or replacement authority.

Exactly one internal shutil.rmtree for current-invocation-owned, still-safe, uncommitted staging. No caller-selected target, prior staging, final directory, permission-repair callback or sweep. Partial cleanup uses ownership, never publication seal authority.

initiators: Future L3.3 materializer with explicit issued MultiSourceCrossDayDatasetResult, pre-existing safe absolute output_root and explicit built_at; no reader/CLI/Catalog/provider initiator.
authority_boundary.mutation_owner: src/market_vault/cross_day_dataset/materialization.py owns only exclusive current staging and the absent-to-published final boundary; publication seal and cleanup ownership are distinct authorities.
forbidden_bypass_layers: No old A4 contract, old Dataset exemption, caller token/hash/seal, skip_validation, raw cleanup path, arbitrary callback or native dispatch can establish authority.

No os.replace, Path.replace, Path.rename, shutil.move, generic os.remove/os.unlink/os.rmdir, final deletion, copy-over, delete-then-rename, repair, quarantine, chmod retry or permission changes to allow overwrite.
No ordinary POSIX rename/renameat, copy+delete fallback, network/remote filesystem, dynamic primitive discovery or unsupported platform success.

Linux native boundary is exactly materialization.py::_rename_directory_no_replace_linux: one renameat2(root_fd, staging_name, root_fd, final_name, RENAME_NOREPLACE=1) call. Current AST inventory does not count native calls; independent source review, exact static wrapper tests and actual platform qualification are mandatory. This limit is not a generic native-mutation allowance.
No checker weakening, exemption change, prospective_transition, wildcard binding, extra occurrence or same-implementation-PR contract redesign.

mutated_assets: Exclusively created <output_root>/.<dataset_id>.tmp-<nonce>/, with 64-lowercase-hex ID and independently generated 32-lowercase-hex nonce (16 random bytes), and only its expected newly created members.
One absent-to-committed <output_root>/dataset_id=<dataset_id>/ sibling, on the identical proved local filesystem/volume.
excluded_assets: Pre-existing output_root and ancestors, existing or racing finals of any validity, all other siblings and crash residue.
Upstream Canonical/Observation/Dataset artifacts, source evidence, repository, Catalog, settings, providers and production data.

allowed_transitions.rationale: Exact input/safety/platform admission, absent final and exclusive staging creation with retained ownership.
Read-only full verification of equivalent existing final, without staging creation.
Invalid input/root/platform or conflicting/corrupt final; no mutation.
Data/specs, manifest, complete private verification, empty _SUCCESS, final verification, then private seal bound to exactly admitted bytes.
Preparation fails; cleanup only of proven owned partial staging.
Immediate exact seal/safety revalidation then one successful no-replace primitive. Revoke cleanup authority before final reader.
Safe existing/racing equivalent final verified read-only; only owned loser staging may be removed.
Any seal drift or primitive failure is fail closed; no final mutation.
Sole reader verifies exact final plus final physical pass, matching requested logical authority.
Postcommit verification fails; report FINAL_VERIFICATION_FAILED, leave final untouched.
Ambiguous interruption around primitive entry: commit outcome unproved. Revoke cleanup authority; read-only recovery only, no final or residue mutation.

forbidden_transitions.rationale: No delete-and-retry or repair of committed final.
Existing final never becomes owned staging.
Retry is a new invocation, not residue adoption.
Uncertainty never grants cleanup or retry-overwrite authority; a new invocation begins read-only.

commit_point.durable_authority: Successful qualified same-filesystem atomic NO-REPLACE publication is the physical mutation commit; _SUCCESS or a seal alone is not commit. Ambiguous interruption never grants final cleanup. Atomic visibility is not a universal power-loss persistence guarantee.
commit_point.success_authoritative_when: Only after strict read-only final verification, full recorded semantic closure and second physical pass, compared to externally requested Dataset authority. Existing equivalent success also requires that verification. No trusted result while COMMITTED_UNVERIFIED or COMMITTED_INVALID.

pre_commit: Crash before manifest, after manifest, after empty _SUCCESS, or immediately before publication leaves non-authoritative private residue. Future invocations never adopt, scan or delete it.
No partially prepared final may be exposed. On ambiguous primitive interruption inspect final read-only; never infer cleanup authority over final.
post_commit: Crash immediately after rename does not authorize rollback. Retry checks final first and returns equivalent verified success or fails untouched.
A failed final verification is COMMITTED_INVALID, not a reason to delete/repair/quarantine. Platform qualification documents persistence limits; restart always verifies.

restorable: Ordinary precommit failure may remove only extant current-created objects under the exact current-owned staging with safe ancestry, same object identities and no unexpected entries. Partial inventory may be a subset; seal completeness is not required for cleanup.
non_restorable: No postcommit rollback. No removal of output_root, final, arbitrary prior staging or unrelated objects.
Uncertain ownership, replaced root/member, link/reparse, unexpected child, denied traversal or ACL drift: refuse cleanup and preserve residue; no chmod fallback.
interruption_detection: Track physical publication separately from verified success and revoke cleanup immediately on successful rename.
Retain original failure and secondary CLEANUP_REFUSED detail; ambiguous publication is PUBLICATION_FAILED with uncertain state, no destructive recovery.

same_request_retry: New invocation checks exact final first; fully verified equivalent returns created_new_build=false without staging.

Exact equivalence binds dataset_id, all 49 identity assertions, recorded logical facts, schema/content and specs; physical serializer bytes/built_at may differ but existing artifact must match its own manifest.
completed_retry: Read-only existing verification, no marker/manifest regeneration, rewriting, relocation or permission changes.
conflicting_retry: Corrupt/conflicting/incomplete/unsafe final fails untouched, with no staging before existing-final admission.
Retry has no authority over previous residue even if its name, ID, marker or old process metadata matches.

lock_authority: True no-replace primitive is destination exclusion authority; exists() is not a lock.
Exclusive staging creation plus private current object ledger is cleanup authority; only genuine single-use _PublicationSeal is publication authority.
lock_scope: Exact retained root, staging and intended final sibling; private owner-only staging and locally controlled ancestry/root. Cooperative writers access only their own staging.
under_lock_revalidation: Before each mutation inspect relevant lstat/reparse-aware ancestry and retained object handles; before publication repeat full exact inventory/content seal and target checks.

Require access controls excluding untrusted mutation during check-to-primitive interval. Unverifiable control fails closed. Hostile administrator/kernel/equivalent owner credentials are outside this guarantee; a hash scan is not a lock.
concurrent_behavior: Windows bound helper uses only qualified non-replacing os.rename. Actual existing empty and nonempty destinations must survive.

Linux exact root-fd-relative renameat2 flag 1 only. EEXIST is destination-exists; ENOTEMPTY needs fresh safe final existence proof. EXDEV fails; ENOSYS/EINVAL/ENOTSUP/EOPNOTSUPP/missing symbol fails unsupported; other errors fail without fallback.
Race loser verifies winner read-only; equivalent success or corrupt/conflicting failure, never overwrite/delete/repair. Only its proven uncommitted staging is cleanup-eligible.

identities: Dataset ID, exact requested logical result and frozen sections 19-21 artifact layout/manifest/recorded projections; no modification of upstream or Dataset identities.

Root/ancestor/staging/final binding and retained filesystem-object identities. Linux fstat st_dev/st_ino/type plus statx mount identity; Windows FileIdInfo volume serial/128-bit FileId plus volume GUID, exact types and reparse-aware paths. Retain handles; no path/mtime-only ownership.

_PublicationSeal binds invocation, dataset_id, exact sorted file/directory inventory, each relative_path/file_role/object identity/byte_size/SHA256, exact manifest bytes/hash, all specs/sidecars/report/matrix and empty _SUCCESS.

Seal issued only by _verify_and_seal_staging(owner) after final private verification including _SUCCESS; capture must equal the verifier's admitted physical facts. _publish(owner, seal) rejects caller-authored, foreign, reused or replacement-constructed seals.
drift_behavior: Immediately before primitive: exact inventory EQUALITY, same roots/directories/file objects, unchanged sizes/hashes/manifest, reconstructed manifest.dataset_id == owner.dataset_id, _SUCCESS empty regular file, safe final sibling and same filesystem. Any mismatch reaches zero no-replace calls.
No callback/await/content write between final revalidation and primitive. Missing expected files fail publication even though safe cleanup can accept partial inventory.

Reject dot/dot-dot/root escape, symlink, junction, every reparse tag, ADS, extra streams, hard links, unexpected members, directory type mismatch, device files and unproved local ancestry. resolve() alone never suffices.

authoritative_evidence: Qualified atomic no-replace success followed by strict final reader verification and second-pass closure.
Strict read-only equivalent existing/race-final verification matched against the requested authority.
non_success_evidence: Staging marker, manifest, caller hashes, partial inventory, seal without issued context, exists() precheck, cleanup completion or mocked primitive happy path.
Platform documentation or A4 qualification alone; no platform is qualified by this design candidate.
integrity_binding: All expected output members plus manifest and _SUCCESS are in the seal, though manifest and marker are not manifest.output_files. Exact regular files, single links, object/size/SHA identity and canonical bytes required.
Logical identity remains the frozen five domains and 49-field payload. Physical file hashes, manifest hash, output path, cwd, mtime, built_at and seal do not enter Dataset ID.

invalidation_triggers.rationale: No UI or plan authority. Mandatory live identity/path/seal revalidation applies regardless of any earlier inspection.

confirmation_invalidation.rationale: No user-data deletion UI. Future runtime needs separate owner authorization and already-approved exact BASE contract.

execution_policy.rationale: Only private future materializer entrypoints; no reader, CLI, Catalog or provider dispatch.

lifecycle_unit: One full frozen output_root/dataset_id=<ID>/ artifact including one Parquet, all recorded evidence/association/spec/report sidecars, canonical manifest and empty marker.
partial_mutation: Exact ordering: input/root checks; exclusive staging; content/spec writes; manifest; complete private verification; empty _SUCCESS; final private verification; private seal; immediate full revalidation; one no-replace primitive; final verification; return.

SUPPORTED_AND_QUALIFIED requires actual exact-tuple tests on local NTFS Windows 11/Server 2022+ with CPython 3.11/3.14, or local ext4 Linux with CPython 3.11/3.14 and reliable renameat2/statx. These are candidate families, not already accepted tuples; everything else is UNSUPPORTED_FAIL_CLOSED.
rollback_expectation: Cleanup only still-proven private uncommitted staging; failed ownership leaves residue.
Published final immutable even if return/reader fails; no rollback deletion. No copy+delete degradation.

retained_dependents: All upstream/source artifacts, old Dataset cohorts, output root, other staging, existing finals, Catalog and production data remain untouched.
refused_cases: Unsafe root/component, remote filesystem, unreliable object IDs, unqualified platform, unproved private access, cross-volume/mount, invalid seal, prior staging or corrupt final.
unsupported_cases: Orphan adoption/sweep/GC, migration, permanent final deletion, quarantine, repair, permission escalation, arbitrary native mutation, new destructive finding or fallback primitive.
Provider/schedule acquisition, network/OpenD, Catalog/CLI, release/deployment; no runtime in this design PR.

permanent_deletion.rationale: Removing owned precommit private staging is internal failure handling, not user-data deletion. No committed artifact or existing persistent asset may be deleted.

implementation_tests: Require the unchanged approved contract in exact implementation BASE; no HEAD-only contract authorization. Exactly the two Python path/symbol/signal/count bindings; no exemptions/checker/prospective transition changes. Linux native wrapper separately audited/tested.

Real Windows and Linux absent-target publication, existing empty/nonempty destination refusal, simultaneous equivalent/conflicting creators; preserve winner bytes and objects. Happy-path or mocked tests alone do not qualify.
Actual Linux renameat2(RENAME_NOREPLACE) and Windows non-replacing os.rename; unsupported primitive/kernel/filesystem/runtime, EXDEV and permissions fail without fallback.

Root/staging/object substitution, symlinks, junctions/reparse including inside-root links, ADS/streams, hard links, mount changes and unsafe ancestry fail before mutation; uncertain cleanup is refused.

After final private verification and before seal issuance or publication, mutate/remove/substitute matrix, each evidence/association/spec/report member, manifest and marker. Assert zero primitive calls, absent final and unchanged unrelated siblings.

Exact inventory rejects added hidden children and missing members. Hashes reject same-size mutation. File identities reject identical-byte substitution. Manifest reconstructs owner.dataset_id; _SUCCESS remains exact empty bytes.
Partial-write failure cleans only current-owned partial staging, not arbitrary prior residue. Permission/ownership uncertainty leaves residue and preserves original error. No chmod-on-error cleanup.
Existing equivalent before staging returns read-only; corrupt final creates no staging. Race equivalents return existing; corrupt winner remains untouched.
Fault/crash checkpoints before manifest, after manifest, after marker, just before/after primitive and during final verification; no postcommit deletion or repair.
Direct/forged/reused/foreign seal rejection; cleanup owner alone cannot reach primitive. No callbacks or writes after immediate revalidation.
New reader remains read-only and passes frozen second-pass TOCTOU, discriminator, relocation, zero-row schema and no-upstream-execution canaries.
Preserve nine existing L3.3 deferred canaries 2,3,38,39,40,61,75,76,77 until real runtime evidence. Design-only tests do not relabel them PASS or rewrite L3.1/L3.2 history.
All 98 Dataset, 49 TS2 and 53 L1/L2 fixed digest assertions and old sealed authorities unchanged. Physical-only mutations never change logical Dataset ID.
Record exact OS/kernel/libc/CPU/Python/filesystem/options/access-control tuple and actual platform logs; untested tuples fail closed. No platform qualification claimed in this design PR.
